Example Bank Limited (synthetic test fixture, not a real company)
Q1 FY2027 Earnings Conference Call
July 19, 2026
Moderator: Ladies and gentlemen, good day and welcome to the Example Bank Q1 FY2027 earnings conference call. I now hand the conference over to Mr. Rajiv Sharma, Chief Financial Officer.
Rajiv Sharma: Good evening. The net interest margin was 4.05% in Q1-2027 compared to 4.10% in Q4-2026.
Total advances grew by 15.6% year-on-year. Total deposits grew by 13.2% year-on-year, and the average CASA ratio was 38.9% in the quarter.
The gross NPA ratio was 1.75% and the net NPA ratio was 0.44% at June 30, 2026. The annualised credit cost was 0.62% for the quarter, reflecting seasonal slippages in the agricultural portfolio.
Our CET-1 ratio was 15.5% and the standalone ROE was 16.0% in Q1-2027. We are happy to take questions.
Moderator: Thank you. We will now begin the question-and-answer session. The first question is from the line of Ankit Shah from Gamma Research. Please go ahead.
Ankit Shah: Thank you. Slippages and the credit cost went up this quarter. Is this stress in unsecured retail or only the seasonal agricultural portfolio, and how should we think about provisions?
Rajiv Sharma: It is largely seasonal. Credit cost should moderate to around 55 basis points for the rest of FY27.
Moderator: Thank you. The next question is from the line of Rohan Mehta from Alpha Securities. Please go ahead.
Rohan Mehta: Fee income growth has been strong. How sustainable is the fee and commission momentum from cross-sell?
Rajiv Sharma: Fees are broad-based across retail and business banking, so we are comfortable with the momentum.
Moderator: Thank you. That was the last question.
